punchline: Hush Puppies went from 30,000 pairs a year to 430,000 without a single ad saying the shoes were cool.
thirty_sec: Hush Puppies sold 30,000 pairs a year and the maker thought of dropping them. Then two executives heard from a stylist that Manhattan kids were buying the shoes in resale shops. Designers called. The next year the company sold 430,000 pairs, and four times that the year after. Nobody had run an ad.
